# dsh-knowledge-work
English | 中文

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds
225 knowledge-work skills across 22 independently switchable rol

e rows — sales,
small business, finance, legal, data, engineering, design, marketing, operations,
pr

oduct, customer support, HR, bio-research, productivity, PDF reading, enterprise
search, plugin auth
oring, plus Apollo, brand-voice, Common Room, Slack, and Zoom.

The skills come from Anthropic's open-source
anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
(Apache-2.0); see ATT
RIBUTION.md for what was ported and how.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`).
- A preset that exposes skil
l discovery and loading (the default presets do).

## Use the skills

Enable the **Knowledge-work skills** bundle in **Plugins**, then turn roles on or
off in the bundle'

s details page. Each role is a separate plugin row: switching
one off unloads its provider and remov

es its skills from the catalog without
touching the other rows. The switches persist in the profile

s from the catalog without
touching the other rows. The switches persist in the profile patch layer.

A skill whose folder name appears in more than one role gets a `<role>-<skill>`
prefix so names stay

stable when neighbouring rows are switched off — for
example `sales-account-research` and `sales-ca

ll-prep` (the same skill names also
exist in Common Room).

Skills are loaded on demand by the model through the skill tool; their bodies are
not part of every
request until selected.

Partner-built rows need their vendor's connector (Apollo, Common Room, Slack,
Zoom). Without it the

skill still loads and explains the workflow, but it cannot
read or write partner data. Brand-voice w
orks from uploaded material.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`cordis.patch.yml` inserts each role as its own Loader row named
`dsh-knowledge-work/<role>`. Each e

ntry registers a skill provider with the
`skills` service and discovers `<role>/<skill>/SKILL.md` un

der `assets/` at
runtime. The package `exports` map serves the role subpaths and their locale
files,
which is how the Plugins page reads row titles without running the code.

Not ported: upstream `.mcp.json` connectors, slash commands, sub-agents, and
plugin settings. See AT

pstream `.mcp.json` connectors, slash commands, sub-agents, and
plugin settings. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`lib/` is committed: git installs fetch sources and do not build them, so rebuild
and commit `lib/`
together with any `src/` change.
## License

Plugin code is MIT (LICENSE). The skill assets under `assets/` keep
their upstream licenses: Apache-

2.0 for first-party skills
(kwp-LICENSE.txt) and the partner license for partner-built
skills. See A

TTRIBUTION.md. The package's SPDX license
expression is `(MIT AND Apache-2.0)`.
